query:
SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.sessionSummary,
  e.therapistUserId,
  u.name as therapist_name,
  p.name as patient_name,
  e.createdAt
FROM evolutions e
LEFT JOIN users u ON e.therapistUserId = u.id
LEFT JOIN patients p ON e.patientId = p.id
ORDER BY e.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
